info.name: GoMate - Auth, Profile & Activities
info.description: Send requests individually: Health -> Register -> enter verificationCode from email -> Verify Email -> Login -> Me -> Get Profile -> Update Profile -> Upload Avatar -> View Avatar -> Logout. For existing accounts start at Login. Optional Resend and Google Login are separate flows. Login supports rememberMe and saves session expiry. Do not run the entire collection blindly: registration requires an email code and profile requests modify the signed-in account. Join Requests folder: use two verified accounts, Login Host -> Create Activity -> Login Member -> Submit, then choose Cancel, Approve or Reject manually.

item.name: 02 - Authentication
item.description: Registration, email verification, login and session management. Send individually; verification requires an email code.

request.description: Điền name, email thật và password trong Variables. Gửi đăng ký, mở hộp thư nhận mã. SMTP phải được cấu hình trong BE. 201: đã gửi mã; 409: email đã tồn tại; 503: chưa cấu hình hoặc gửi email thất bại.
Nhập mã 6 số từ email vào biến verificationCode rồi Send. Mã có hiệu lực 10 phút, tối đa 5 lần nhập và chỉ dùng một lần. 200: xác minh thành công; 400: mã sai, hết hạn hoặc hết lượt.

Dùng khi chưa nhận được mã hoặc mã hết hạn. Chờ tối thiểu 60 giây giữa các lần gửi; mã mới thay thế mã cũ. Nhập mã mới vào verificationCode rồi chạy Verify Email. HTTP 200 là thông báo chung, không bảo đảm email được gửi nếu tài khoản không cần xác minh hoặc còn thời gian chờ.

Login after email verification. rememberMe=true: default 30 days; false: default 24 hours. Saves accessToken, userId, expiresAt and expiresIn. 403: verify email; 401: incorrect credentials. No refresh token; expired sessions require login again.
Điền googleIdToken thật được cấp cho GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID của BE. Tự lưu token GoMate sau khi thành công. Không cần mã email riêng.

Restore/check the saved session. Returns user, expiresAt and remaining expiresIn. 401 AUTH_REQUIRED or SESSION_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED clears saved session variables; network/5xx errors do not. Calling Me does not extend the session.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 for a valid session', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Expiry metadata', () => { pm.expect(data.expiresIn).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(data.expiresAt))).to.eql(true); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('expiresAt', data.expiresAt); pm.collectionVariables.set('expiresIn', String(data.expiresIn)); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', data.user.id); }

item.name: Password Recovery & Change
item.description: Forgot -> enter emailed resetCode -> Reset, OR Login -> Change. Do not run all requests sequentially.

request.description: Send individually. Reset/change revoke ALL sessions, including host/member tokens. Update password variables and log in again after success. See docs/password-recovery.md.

item.name: 03 - Profile
item.description: Read and update the signed-in profile and avatar. Uses accessToken.

request.description: Read your profile before editing. Saves avatarPath and userId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const p = pm.response.json().profile; pm.test('Profile returned', () => { pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p).not.to.have.property('password_hash'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', p.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('avatarUrl', p.avatarUrl ? (p.avatarUrl.startsWith('https://') ? p.avatarUrl : pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + p.avatarUrl) : ''); }

request.description: Updates the signed-in account only. Edit body fields or collection variables. Unknown fields are rejected; username collisions return 409. Omit fields to keep existing values. Empty username removes it.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const p = pm.response.json().profile; pm.test('Profile returned', () => { pm.expect(p.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p).not.to.have.property('password_hash'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', p.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('avatarUrl', p.avatarUrl ? request.description: Body > form-data > avatar (File) > Select Files. Select a local image and Send. Backend uploads to Cloudinary and returns the HTTPS avatar URL. Do not manually set Content-Type; Postman adds the multipart boundary. Cloudinary credentials belong only in backend .env.

request.description: Run after a successful Upload Avatar, or Get Profile if an avatar already exists. Public image: no Bearer token required.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('avatarUrl')) { throw new Error('No avatarUrl. Upload an avatar or run Get Profile first.'); }

item.name: 04 - Activities
item.description: Search and manage activities. Create saves activityId; Delete is manual. Uses accessToken.

request.description: Login first. Enable optional Params to search. For distance enable lat, lng and distanceKm together. days uses ISO weekday 1=Monday, 7=Sunday; hours use UTC+7. Returns future published activities with free places, excluding your own. Empty database returns items=[].

exec: if(pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Paginated activities', () => { pm.expect(data.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(data.hasMore).to.be.a('boolean'); }); }

request.description: Creates a published activity owned by the signed-in account. Optional coverBase64 uploads a local image to Cloudinary. Dates must be ISO UTC. Blank date variables default to tomorrow. Saves activityId.
Owner only; omit unchanged fields. Started activities cannot be edited. Capacity must be at least the current member count.
Owner only. Removes this activity from discovery, detail and owner list by marking it deleted. Send only when you intend to delete activityId.

item.name: 05 - Join Requests
item.description: Send individually: Login Host -> Create Activity -> Login Member -> Submit -> List. Choose Cancel, Approve OR Reject. Submit again after cancel/reject saves a new ID. Approved requests cannot be cancelled.

item.name: 01 - Setup (two accounts)
item.description: Run in order to prepare separate host/member tokens and an activity.

request.description: Login a verified account. Saves only the role-specific token, not the shared accessToken. Host and member must be different accounts.
